newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldier kills Arab assailant in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier kills Arab assailant in West Bank.

text.p: An Israeli soldier shot dead a Palestinian teenager who stabbed another soldier near a Jewish settlement in the West Bank on Tuesday, the army said.
An army spokesman said the Palestinian attacked troops on patrol outside the Elon Moreh settlement near Nablus, drawing gunfire from one of the soldiers.
"I got out of the vehicle...he lunged at me and stabbed me in the arm," said the wounded soldier, Yigal Marleshvili.
"The two soldiers sitting in the back got out. One kicked him and the other shot him," he told reporters from his hospital bed.
A witness who arrived after the shooting said the Palestinian had a bullet wound in the chest and was lying in a pool of blood.
Palestinians who saw the dead man's identity card named him as Muadi Izzal Alawnweh, 18, from the West Bank village of Azmout.

PLO officials said Israel had closed off the area and initially prevented Palestinian policemen from investigating the incident. They said the Nablus police commander was later allowed to inspect the scene.
Military sources said later soldiers fired rubber bullets to disperse dozens of protesters in the West Bank town of Qalqilya, about 20 km (12 miles) west of Nablus.
Israel handed over parts of the West Bank and Gaza Strip to Palestinian rule under peace deals since 1993 but much of the area remains under Israeli military control.
Around 130,000 Jewish settlers live among one million Palestinians in the West Bank which Israel captured in the 1967 Middle East war.
